title: "STELLARIS COLLECTION"
paragraph_01: After having returned to Stellaris during its 4.3.0 performance update after being absent from the game since 2023, I gained a new interest in the game after having tried it again. Having been a vivid HOI4 modder for a while, I felt like I had to create a mod around something that had bugged me since the first time I tried the game.
paragraph_02: There are always something about the flag of the interstellar empire you were playing that bugged me off in the fact that it didn't look like a flag at all, so I wished to make it so that it would look like a flag. And since all Paradox games shares the same bracket language, this would be quite an easy job
paragraph_03:
The difficult part of creating the mod would not to find the backgrounds in Stellaris localization, it would be to apply the flag overlay.
I would first try to make a transparent background that could be applied to any background on a flag, but that did not work, so in the end I ended up finding a white flag, scaling that up, then placing that in a layer set to be "Hard Light". This essentially makes it so the layer/image is lighted on the layer below it per its color.
I would sit for a bit on the mod to try perfect it, going from different types of overlays, like curtains to see what could make the best display for a flag.
paragraph_04: And when I had finished a background layer for the flag, instead of having to manually apply that for every single 50 or so flags that were in Stellaris, I had Claude take the flag overlay, then apply that for me for all the flags under 10 seconds, saving me a few hours of me doing it instead. And as such I had made the "Flag Overlay" mod for Stellaris
paragraph_05: There are always something about the flag of the interstellar empire you were playing that bugged me off in the fact that it didn't look like a flag at all, so I wished to make it so that it would look like a flag. And since all Paradox games shares the same bracket language, this would be quite an easy job
paragraph_06: The "Flag Overlay" mod released to positive receptions, with players liking the small but significant change to the game's empire flags
paragraph_07: Over the coming weeks I would continue to make submods of other mods with flags, so I could give them the same overlay treatment based upon players requests
